title: Evaluation of Non-Invasive Assays for the Detection of Urothelial Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if analysis of DNA and protein material found in urine will be useful in the detection of urothelial cancer of the bladder and kidney. This analysis may be helpful to determine if how a particular cancer will act regarding remission and recurrence
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients scheduled to have a nephroureterectomy, cystectomy, cytoscopy (newly diagnosed bladder cancer and those with recurrent disease in follow up)
* Control Group: No known evidence of bladder cancer-one urine sample
* \> than 18 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< than 18 years of age
study_population: Lahey Clinic patients presenting to the Department of Urology and Primary Care Referrals
